summary: 1stdibs.com filed an 8-K reporting Q3 2026 results alongside a planned CEO transition. CEO David Rosenblatt notified the board on November 2, 2026 of his resignation as CEO effective January 1, 2027, moving to Executive Chairperson; he ceases to be an executive officer. Chief Product and Marketing Officer Bradford Shellhammer succeeds him as CEO and principal executive officer on that date, and is expected to join the board via a one-seat expansion. The orderly, pre-announced succession tempers the abruptness; watch board composition and strategic continuity.
